kevin: Heads up — ruby sampleapp CI is failing on Windows agents. ffi LoadError when trying to load the compiled lib: 
```
LoadError: could not open file or shared object: libsample_ext.so
from /opt/hostedtoolcache/ruby/3.1.0/gems/ffi-1.15.4/lib/ffi/library.rb:145:in `ffi_lib'
```
kevin: It looks like the gem falls back to C extension on Linux but our Windows CI expects the ffi shared lib to be found differently.
maria: Which ffi version are we testing against? Windows has weird search-path rules for .dlls.
jen: I'm reproing locally on WSL2 and native Windows. On native I see the gem installs but the .dll isn't in PATH so LoadError. On WSL it works.
kevin: CI matrix: ruby 2.7, 3.0, 3.1 on windows-latest, ubuntu-latest. Only windows-latest fails.
ci-bot: build #402 failed — see https://ci.redwood.example/402 for logs (exit code 1).
alex: Possible short fixes: ship a precompiled Windows extension in the gem, or fall back to FFI. Also we can add runtime lookup with `FFI::Library::ffi_lib(File.expand_path('../ext/sample_ext/sample_ext.dll', __dir__))`.
maria: Prebuilt binaries means maintaining artifacts for each ruby/platform matrix — extra overhead. I'd prefer a runtime search + docs note for now.
jen: Proposed quick patch: try explicit `ffi_lib` with relative path, then try `ffi_lib 'sample_ext'` as fallback, then raise helpful error with troubleshooting link. Also add a Windows step to CI that verifies `ruby -r ./lib/sample_ext.rb -e 'puts :ok'` exits 0.
kevin: Sounds good. Can you open a tiny PR that only implements the fallback + clearer error text? We'll follow up with a release that adds a binary gem if adoption warrants.
jen: Will do. I'll also add a short note to the onboarding README under "Windows troubleshooting" with the `ENV['PATH']` hint and the `where sample_ext.dll` command.
alex: For PR review please include a unit test that stubs `FFI::Library.ffi_lib` to simulate missing PATH so we don't regress.
kevin: One more: add an entry in CHANGELOG.md under "devex / sampleapps" so customers see the fix.
jen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/128 — implements fallback, test, and README blurb. PTAL @maria @kevin.
maria: Reviewing now. Quick glance: test uses temp dir + manipulates `ENV['PATH']` — good. A tiny nit: error message could point to the specific gem version. I'll leave inline comment. :thumbsup:
kevin: Thanks — once merged I'll cut a patch release and update the quickstart snippet in docs.
jen: Awesome, thx all.
ci-bot: build #403 triggered for PR 128 on windows-latest.
kevin: If CI still flakes after the patch, we escalate to shipping a platform gem. For now we keep this minimal so onboarding isn't blocked.
